COMPUTER CHOICE — sound routine 3

This is the third of seven Computer Choice BASIC routines supplied in the Spectrum Show collection. The full original CompChoice TAP is kept with routine 1. We kept the single-program List3 TAP and TZX bytes unchanged, and decoded the one-line List3.bas from the TZX with the ZX-UX ROM LLIST reader.

This routine writes alternating values to the Spectrum's port 254 and goes back to its only line. The source has no end condition, score, moving graphics or player keys. We loaded its tape in Fuse 48K, entered RUN and captured the screen after starting the loop. The program has no screen output. Audio was disabled in the emulator, so these pictures cannot confirm any sound. The beeper remains camera-shy.

REPLAY.sh runs the original TZX in Fuse SDL with Xvfb, Python 3, Pillow and python-xlib. No native build was made.
